cover.alt: M12-Codierung und Pinbelegung: D, X und Ansichten

articles.description: Spezifizieren Sie eine M12-Konfektion nach Codierung, Kontakten und Verdrahtung. Erst anschließend wird der mechanische Einbau geprüft. Die Bezeichnung M12 allein reicht für eine Bestellung nicht aus.
articles.excerpt: Spezifizieren Sie eine M12-Konfektion nach Codierung, Kontakten und Verdrahtung. Erst anschließend wird der mechanische Einbau geprüft. Die Bezeichnung M12 allein reicht für eine Bestellung nicht aus.

relatedLinks.label: Molex · M12 coding and contact configurations

sections.heading: Geräteanschluss vollständig erfassen
paragraphs: Übernehmen Sie die vollständige Anschlussbezeichnung aus dem Gerätehandbuch. D- und X-Codierung kommen bei M12-Ethernet-Produkten vor. Wählen Sie den Ersatz nicht allein nach Gewindegröße, sondern prüfen Sie die Codierung beider Enden.

sections.heading: Pinbelegung eindeutig darstellen
paragraphs: Notieren Sie Kontaktzahl, Stift- oder Buchsenkontakte und jede Pinverbindung. Kennzeichnen Sie Steck- oder Verdrahtungsansicht. Führen Sie die Schirmverbindung getrennt von Signalpins auf und lassen Sie unbenutzte Kontakte bestätigen.

sections.heading: Kompletten Anschluss prüfen
paragraphs: Prüfen Sie gerade oder gewinkelte Bauform, Schraubzugang, Kabelabgang und Gegenstück. Vereinbaren Sie elektrische und umgebungsbezogene Anforderungen für die gesamte Konfektion. Eine passende Codierung ist noch kein geprüfter Leistungsnachweis.

sections.heading: M12 D-codiert oder X-codiert: austauschbar?
paragraphs: Nein. D-codierte Ethernet-Stecker haben üblicherweise vier Kontakte, X-codierte acht und eine andere Codierung. Wählen Sie nach dem jeweiligen Geräteanschluss. Polzahl oder M12-Gewinde allein bestätigen keine Ethernet-Leistung der gesamten Konfektion.

sections.heading: Wie prüft man die Pinbelegung M12 auf RJ45?
paragraphs: Verwenden Sie die konkrete Zeichnung und kennzeichnen Sie Steckgesicht oder Verdrahtungsseite beider Enden. Ordnen Sie M12-Kontakte den RJ45-Positionen zu; prüfen Sie Schirmung und unbenutzte Kontakte getrennt. Übernehmen Sie keine Aderfarben eines anderen Modells.

sections.heading: Was benötigt ein M8/M12-Sensorkabel mit offenem Ende?
paragraphs: Geben Sie Geräteanschluss, Codierung, Kontaktgeschlecht, Polzahl und Aderzuordnung jedes verwendeten Pins an. Klären Sie freie Aderlänge und Anschlusstechnik. Ein offenes Ende ersetzt keine Definition der geräteseitigen Zuordnung und macht Sensorschnittstellen nicht austauschbar.

cover.alt: GigE Vision Packet Loss: Cable or Network?

articles.description: Troubleshoot GigE Vision packet loss by separating the physical connection from network load and acquisition settings. Use controlled comparisons before deciding that a replacement cable is required.
articles.excerpt: Troubleshoot GigE Vision packet loss by separating the physical connection from network load and acquisition settings. Use controlled comparisons before deciding that a replacement cable is required.

sections.heading: Is packet loss always a cable problem?
paragraphs: No. Record incomplete images, resend counters and the exact operating conditions first. Compare the same camera and acquisition settings on a known-good connection. Change only one element per comparison and retain the results so a cable fault can be distinguished from a host, switch or configuration issue.

sections.heading: Check the physical link before tuning parameters
paragraphs: Inspect connector seating, lock engagement, damaged cable sections and strain at the cable exit. For an M12-to-RJ45 assembly, confirm coding and the approved pin map. Compare the intended route with a known-good cable while keeping the camera, host and settings unchanged. Follow the equipment instructions for connection and power handling.

sections.heading: Review packet size, inter-packet delay and shared traffic
paragraphs: Check packet-size support across the camera, network interface and any switch. Use the camera supplier's procedure rather than copying one jumbo-frame setting into every system. Inter-packet delay can reduce incoming packet pressure but also affects throughput. Review simultaneous cameras, bandwidth use and the required frame rate together.

sections.heading: What evidence should go to technical support?
paragraphs: Send a network sketch, device and driver versions, acquisition settings, counters and the comparison log. If loss occurs only with several cameras or a particular switch, investigate that shared path. Stop speculative changes when power, grounding or device behavior is unclear and involve the equipment supplier.

bullets: Changing cable, driver and packet settings together, then attributing the result to one cause.
Promising that a shielded cable or jumbo frames will solve every dropped frame.

bullets: Camera, host network interface and switch models
Cable model, length, route and M12 coding if relevant
Resolution, frame rate, packet settings and camera count

articles.description: Unterscheiden Sie feste Verlegung, wiederholte Biegung und Torsion vor der Kabelauswahl. Der tatsächliche Bewegungsablauf ist aussagekräftiger als die pauschale Forderung nach Flexibilität.
articles.excerpt: Unterscheiden Sie feste Verlegung, wiederholte Biegung und Torsion vor der Kabelauswahl. Der tatsächliche Bewegungsablauf ist aussagekräftiger als die pauschale Forderung nach Flexibilität.

sections.heading: Bewegungsart einordnen
paragraphs: Markieren Sie feste Bereiche, Biegung in der Energiekette und Verdrehung um eine Achse. Dauerbiegung und Torsion sind unterschiedliche Belastungen. Zeigen Sie bei Kombinationen, wo und ob beide gleichzeitig auftreten.

sections.heading: Einbaubedingungen erfassen
paragraphs: Nennen Sie verfügbaren Biegeradius, Verfahrweg, Geschwindigkeit, Beschleunigung und Zyklenplan. Ergänzen Sie Kettenführung, Befestigung und Öl- oder Wärmebelastung. Zeigen Sie den Bewegungsbeginn relativ zu Stecker und Zugentlastung.

sections.heading: Passende Erprobung vereinbaren
paragraphs: Fragen Sie nach einem Kabelaufbau und Prüfplan für diese Anwendung. Definieren Sie Signalprüfungen und Inspektionsintervalle am Muster. Vergleichen Sie genannte Lebensdauerwerte mit deren Prüfbedingungen, bevor Sie diese in die Einkaufsspezifikation übernehmen.

sections.heading: Continuous Flex oder Torsion: genügt eine Einstufung?
paragraphs: Wiederholtes Biegen in der Schleppkette und Torsion um die Achse sind unterschiedliche Belastungen. Continuous Flex allein belegt keine Torsionseignung. Beschreiben Sie beide Bewegungen und verlangen Sie eine Prüfung der tatsächlichen Kombination statt einer pauschalen Robotereignung.

sections.heading: Wie lassen sich Biegeradius und Lebensdauer vergleichen?
paragraphs: Dokumentieren Sie Konstruktion, Einbauradius, Weg, Geschwindigkeit, Beschleunigung, Temperatur, Torsionswinkel und Ausfallkriterium. Zyklen ohne diese Bedingungen sind nicht direkt vergleichbar. Fordern Sie Prüfbelege an oder vereinbaren Sie einen Mustertest; hier wird keine Qicable-Lebensdauer zugesagt.

bullets: Einen weichen Mantel mit Dauerbewegungseignung gleichsetzen.

cover.alt: USB auf RS485: Polarität, Terminierung und Timeouts

articles.description: USB-RS485-Verdrahtung, A/B-Definitionen, Terminierung und Geräteeinstellungen vor einem Konvertertausch prüfen. Beide Handbücher nutzen und jeden Vergleich dokumentieren.
articles.excerpt: USB-RS485-Verdrahtung, A/B-Definitionen, Terminierung und Geräteeinstellungen vor einem Konvertertausch prüfen. Beide Handbücher nutzen und jeden Vergleich dokumentieren.

relatedLinks.label: Texas Instruments · The RS-485 Design Guide

sections.heading: Wie lässt sich die RS485-A/B-Polarität prüfen?
paragraphs: Ordnen Sie Adern nicht allein nach Farbe oder A/B-Buchstaben zu. Vergleichen Sie Konverter- und Gerätehandbuch einschließlich Signaldefinitionen und Ansichten. Folgen Sie der Herstellervorgabe zur Korrektur; an unbekannten spannungsführenden Klemmen nicht experimentieren. Versorgung, Signalbezug und Schutzleiter getrennt behandeln.

sections.heading: Wo ist die Terminierung zu prüfen?
paragraphs: Prüfen Sie Bustopologie und vorhandene Abschlüsse anhand der Geräteunterlagen. Terminierung ist eine Netzwerkauslegung und kein Widerstand an jedem Teilnehmer. Erfassen Sie interne Abschlüsse und Biasing vor Ergänzungen. Dokumentieren Sie Abzweige und Längen für die Prüfung der gesamten Verbindung.

sections.heading: Warum tritt ein Modbus-Timeout auf?
paragraphs: Prüfen Sie zunächst seriellen Port und unterstützten Treiber, dann Baudrate, Parität, Stoppbits, Geräteadresse und Protokoll. RS485 definiert eine elektrische Schnittstelle und garantiert keine Modbus-Kompatibilität. Prüfen Sie eine zulässige Einzelgeräteverbindung, bevor Sie weitere Teilnehmer ergänzen.

sections.heading: Was ist beim konkreten Konverter zu bestätigen?
paragraphs: Fordern Sie Anschlussplan, unterstützte Betriebssysteme, Treiberquelle und Angaben zu Schnittstelle, Isolation und Versorgung an. USB- oder RS485-Bezeichnungen belegen keinen Chipsatz oder Isolationswert. Senden Sie bei offenen Fehlern Handbücher und Vergleichsprotokoll.

cover.alt: Pérdida de paquetes GigE Vision: ¿cable o red?

articles.description: Separe conexión física, carga de red y ajustes al investigar pérdidas de paquetes GigE Vision. Compare de forma controlada antes de atribuir el fallo al cable.
articles.excerpt: Separe conexión física, carga de red y ajustes al investigar pérdidas de paquetes GigE Vision. Compare de forma controlada antes de atribuir el fallo al cable.

sections.heading: ¿La pérdida de paquetes siempre es culpa del cable?
paragraphs: No. Registre imágenes incompletas, contadores de reenvío y condiciones. Compare la misma cámara y ajustes mediante una conexión conocida. Cambie solo un elemento y conserve resultados para separar cable, host, switch y configuración.

sections.heading: Compruebe primero la conexión física
paragraphs: Revise inserción, bloqueo, daños y esfuerzo en la salida. En conjuntos M12 a RJ45, confirme codificación y plano de pines aprobado. Compare con un cable conocido sin cambiar cámara, host ni ajustes. Siga las instrucciones del equipo para conexiones y alimentación.

sections.heading: Revise tamaño de paquete y retardo entre paquetes
paragraphs: Compruebe el tamaño admitido por cámara, tarjeta de red y switch. Siga el procedimiento del fabricante; no copie un ajuste jumbo a todos los sistemas. El retardo entre paquetes puede aliviar la carga, pero afecta al caudal. Revise cámaras simultáneas, ancho de banda y frecuencia requerida.

sections.heading: ¿Qué enviar a soporte?
paragraphs: Envíe esquema de red, versiones, ajustes, contadores y registro comparativo. Si el fallo aparece con varias cámaras o un switch concreto, investigue ese trayecto compartido. Detenga cambios especulativos si alimentación, tierra o comportamiento son inciertos y consulte al fabricante.

bullets: Cambiar cable, controlador y ajustes a la vez.

paragraphs: Registre os modelos da câmera e do host, a interface e o conector correspondente. Inclua trava e direção de saída. Separe dados de imagem, alimentação e disparo no desenho para especificar cada ligação.

sections.heading: Descrever percurso e movimento
paragraphs: Meça o percurso instalado, incluindo folgas de manutenção e acesso aos parafusos. Identifique trechos fixos, esteiras e torção. A interface não comprova aptidão para movimento; consulte a especificação do cabo em questão.

sections.heading: Definir a aceitação da amostra
paragraphs: Combine como verificar montagem e aquisição de imagens no equipamento previsto. Registre parâmetros de captura, duração e sequência de movimento. Guarde essa configuração com o desenho aprovado para novos pedidos.

sections.heading: O que verificar num cabo USB3 Vision com parafusos?
paragraphs: Verifique separadamente conectores da câmara e host, posições dos parafusos, roscas, acesso e saída. Peça vistas do conjunto exato. Micro-B ou bloqueio por parafusos não provam comprimento, alimentação ou aptidão para movimento.

sections.heading: Camera Link MDR ou SDR: podem as pontas diferir?
paragraphs: Sim. Defina separadamente câmara e placa de aquisição; pode ser necessário MDR para SDR. Reveja modo, ligações e PoCL nos dois manuais. A família do conector não valida todas as configurações Camera Link.

sections.heading: Como escolher BNC, DIN ou HD-BNC para CoaXPress?

cover.alt: Flexión continua y torsión: definir el movimiento

articles.description: Distinga instalación fija, flexión repetida y torsión antes de elegir el cable. Describir el movimiento real resulta más útil que pedir simplemente un cable flexible.
articles.excerpt: Distinga instalación fija, flexión repetida y torsión antes de elegir el cable. Describir el movimiento real resulta más útil que pedir simplemente un cable flexible.

sections.heading: Clasificar el movimiento
paragraphs: Marque dónde el cable permanece fijo, se dobla en una cadena o gira sobre su eje. La flexión continua y la torsión son cargas diferentes. Si se combinan, indique dónde y si ocurren simultáneamente.

sections.heading: Registrar las condiciones de montaje
paragraphs: Facilite radio disponible, recorrido, velocidad, aceleración y programa de ciclos. Añada disposición de la cadena, fijaciones y exposición a aceite o calor. Localice el inicio del movimiento respecto al conector y al alivio de tensión.

sections.heading: Acordar una validación representativa
paragraphs: Solicite una construcción y un ensayo adecuados a la instalación. Defina comprobaciones de señal e intervalos de inspección. Compare cualquier cifra de vida útil con las condiciones de ensayo antes de incluirla en la especificación de compra.

sections.heading: Flexión continua frente a torsión: ¿basta una clasificación?
paragraphs: La flexión en cadena y el giro sobre un eje son cargas distintas. Una declaración continuous-flex no prueba aptitud para torsión. Describa ambas y solicite validación de la combinación real, sin deducir aptitud para una articulación robótica.

sections.heading: ¿Cómo comparar radio mínimo y vida en ciclos?
paragraphs: Registre construcción, radio, recorrido, velocidad, aceleración, temperatura, ángulo de torsión y criterio de fallo. Los ciclos sin esas condiciones no son comparables. Solicite registros o acuerde una prueba; esta guía no declara vida en ciclos Qicable.

sections.heading: Identifier les deux extrémités
paragraphs: Notez les modèles de caméra et d’hôte, l’interface et le connecteur associé. Précisez verrouillage et orientation de sortie. Séparez données d’image, alimentation et déclenchement sur le plan pour spécifier chaque liaison.

sections.heading: Décrire parcours et mouvement
paragraphs: Mesurez le parcours installé, avec boucles de réserve et accès aux vis. Identifiez les parties fixes, chaînes porte-câbles et torsions. L’interface seule ne prouve pas l’aptitude au mouvement ; consultez la spécification du câble concerné.

sections.heading: Définir la réception de l’échantillon
paragraphs: Convenez d’un contrôle du montage et de l’acquisition sur l’équipement prévu. Consignez paramètres d’image, durée et séquence de mouvement. Conservez ce protocole avec le plan approuvé pour les commandes suivantes.

sections.heading: Que vérifier sur un câble USB3 Vision à verrouillage par vis ?
paragraphs: Vérifiez séparément connecteurs caméra et hôte, positions des vis, filetage, accès et sortie. Demandez les vues de l’assemblage exact. Micro-B ou verrouillage par vis ne prouvent ni longueur, ni alimentation, ni aptitude au mouvement.

sections.heading: Camera Link MDR ou SDR : les extrémités peuvent-elles différer ?
paragraphs: Oui. Définissez séparément caméra et carte d’acquisition ; MDR vers SDR peut être nécessaire. Vérifiez mode, liaisons et PoCL dans les deux manuels. La famille du connecteur ne valide pas toutes les configurations Camera Link.

sections.heading: Comment choisir BNC, DIN ou HD-BNC pour CoaXPress ?
paragraphs: Relevez la désignation exacte des deux ports. Contrôlez verrouillage, accès, débit, longueur et PoCXP avec les deux manuels. Demandez une vérification de l’assemblage ; cette liste ne certifie aucun modèle Qicable pour une caméra ou un débit CXP donné.

sections.heading: ما المعلومات اللازمة للتسعير؟
paragraphs: حدّد الجهازين أو أرقام الموصلات ونوع التلامس والترميز والقفل واتجاه الخروج. عرّف نقاط قياس الطول والسماحية والتفرعات. أضف كميات العينات والإنتاج والوجهة والتاريخ المطلوب. اطلب توثيق الافتراضات والاستثناءات في العرض.

sections.heading: كيف يُعرّف الرسم وتوزيع الأطراف؟
paragraphs: ميّز وجه التزاوج عن جهة الأسلاك وعيّن الإشارات والتدريع والأطراف غير المستخدمة. حدّد إصدارًا وسجّل النقاط المفتوحة. عند غياب الرسم أرسل صور المنافذ والوثائق للمراجعة. الرسم العام للموصل ليس رسم إنتاج معتمدًا.

sections.heading: كيف يتم الاتفاق على قبول العينة؟
paragraphs: افصل الملاءمة الميكانيكية والفحوص الكهربائية وتشغيل المعدات. اتفق مسبقًا على الطريقة والحدود والعدد ومعايير النجاح. وثّق ظروف الحركة والبيئة ذات الصلة. فحص الاستمرارية لا يثبت السرعة العالية أو الإحكام أو العمر الدوري.

sections.heading: ما المطلوب قبل تكرار الإنتاج؟
paragraphs: اربط العينة المعتمدة وإصدار الرسم بالطلب. أكّد الملصقات والتغليف وسجلات الاختبار وآلية مراجعة البدائل والتغييرات. اسأل عن الحد الأدنى وصلاحية السعر والأدوات والمدة لهذا التكوين؛ لا تعد هذه القائمة بكمية أو مهلة موحدة.

cover.alt: Perda de pacotes GigE Vision: cabo ou rede?

articles.description: Separe ligação física, carga da rede e ajustes ao investigar perdas de pacotes GigE Vision. Compare de forma controlada antes de culpar o cabo.
articles.excerpt: Separe ligação física, carga da rede e ajustes ao investigar perdas de pacotes GigE Vision. Compare de forma controlada antes de culpar o cabo.

sections.heading: A perda de pacotes é sempre um problema do cabo?
paragraphs: Não. Registe imagens incompletas, contadores de reenvio e condições. Compare a mesma câmara e ajustes numa ligação conhecida. Altere apenas um elemento e guarde resultados para distinguir cabo, host, switch e configuração.

sections.heading: Verifique primeiro a ligação física
paragraphs: Inspecione encaixe, bloqueio, danos e esforço na saída. Em M12 para RJ45 confirme codificação e pinagem aprovada. Compare com um cabo conhecido sem alterar câmara, host ou ajustes. Respeite as instruções do equipamento sobre ligação e alimentação.

sections.heading: Tamanho de pacote e intervalo entre pacotes
paragraphs: Verifique o tamanho suportado pela câmara, placa e switch. Siga o procedimento do fabricante em vez de aplicar o mesmo jumbo frame a todos os sistemas. O intervalo entre pacotes pode reduzir a pressão de chegada, mas afeta o débito. Considere câmaras simultâneas, largura de banda e frequência.

sections.heading: O que enviar ao apoio técnico?
paragraphs: Envie esquema de rede, versões, ajustes, contadores e comparação. Se a falha surgir com várias câmaras ou um switch específico, investigue esse percurso comum. Pare alterações especulativas quando alimentação, terra ou funcionamento forem incertos e consulte o fabricante.

bullets: Alterar cabo, controlador e parâmetros ao mesmo tempo.
Prometer que blindagem ou jumbo frames resolvem todas as perdas.

sections.heading: هل يوجد طول أقصى موحد لكابل USB3 Vision؟
paragraphs: لا يثبت طول واحد عمل جميع مجموعات الكاميرا والمضيف. سجّل معدل البيانات واستهلاك الكاميرا ووحدة تحكم المضيف والطول المركب. اختر التكوين وفق وثائق المعدات ثم اختبره على التجهيز المقصود.

sections.heading: ما الفرق بين النحاس السلبي والنشط والخيار البصري؟
paragraphs: الكابل السلبي لا يتضمن إلكترونيات لتكييف الإشارة، بينما يضيفها النحاس النشط وتحول الخيارات البصرية مسار البيانات. تحقق من تغذية الإلكترونيات والكاميرا واتجاه الأطراف وحدود التركيب والحركة. زيادة الطول لا تجعل البديل قابلًا للاستبدال المباشر تلقائيًا.

sections.heading: ماذا يشمل اختبار كابل كاميرا بقفل لولبي؟
paragraphs: راجع التزاوج والوصول إلى البراغي واتجاه الخروج وتخفيف الشد. سجّل الدقة وتنسيق البكسل ومعدل الإطارات والمضيف والتغذية والمدة. كرر الاختبار بالحركة والبيئة المقصودتين. احفظ سجلات الأخطاء مع إصدار الرسم؛ الاختبار القصير في السكون لا يعادل قبول التركيب الكامل.

sections.heading: متى ينبغي إعادة تصميم الوصلة؟
paragraphs: غيّر عاملًا واحدًا في كل مرة: قارن بوصلة قصيرة معروفة، ثم راجع التغذية والمضيف، ثم ناقش تقنية أخرى مع مورّد المعدات. اطلب مراجعة التكوين من Qicable؛ هذا الدليل لا يحدد طولًا أقصى مختبرًا لأي طراز Qicable.

sections.heading: Störumgebung erfassen
paragraphs: Markieren Sie Antriebe, Motoren und Schaltnetzteile nahe dem Signalweg. Zeigen Sie Schrankeinführungen, parallele Leitungen und Erdungspunkte. Notieren Sie Fehlerbedingungen, damit die Musterprüfung den relevanten Betriebszustand nachbildet.

sections.heading: Schirmanschluss festlegen
paragraphs: Befolgen Sie die EMV-Vorgaben des Geräts für Schirmanbindung und Stecker. Verwenden Sie keine allgemeine Regel für ein- oder beidseitigen Anschluss. Dokumentieren Sie die Kontaktierung und behandeln Sie Schutzerdung getrennt von funktionaler Schirmung.

sections.heading: Gesamten Einbau verifizieren
paragraphs: Vereinbaren Sie Prüfungen der vorgesehenen Schirmverbindungen und des Signalbetriebs in der Maschine. Dokumentieren Sie Änderungen an Verlegung und Erdung bei der Fehlersuche. Lassen Sie die endgültige Ausführung vor Serienübernahme elektrotechnisch freigeben.

sections.heading: وصف المسار والحركة
paragraphs: قس المسار بعد التركيب مع طول الصيانة والمساحة اللازمة للوصول إلى البراغي. حدد الأجزاء الثابتة وسلاسل الكابلات ومناطق الالتواء. اسم الواجهة لا يثبت ملاءمة الحركة؛ راجع مواصفات الكابل المحدد.

sections.heading: تحديد اختبار قبول العينة
paragraphs: اتفق على فحص الملاءمة والتقاط الصور باستخدام المعدات المقصودة. سجّل إعدادات التصوير ومدة التشغيل وتسلسل الحركة. احتفظ بهذه الإعدادات مع الرسم المعتمد للطلبات اللاحقة.

sections.heading: ماذا أفحص في كابل USB3 Vision بقفل لولبي؟
paragraphs: افحص طرفي الكاميرا والمضيف منفصلين، بما في ذلك مواضع البراغي والسنون والوصول واتجاه الخروج. اطلب مناظر التجميعة المحددة. لا يثبت اسم Micro-B أو القفل اللولبي الطول أو التغذية أو ملاءمة الحركة.

sections.heading: Camera Link MDR مقابل SDR: هل يمكن أن يختلف الطرفان؟
paragraphs: نعم. حدّد موصل الكاميرا وموصل بطاقة الالتقاط منفصلين؛ قد تحتاج تجميعة MDR إلى SDR. راجع الوضع والوصلات المطلوبة وPoCL في الدليلين. عائلة الموصل وحدها لا تثبت توافق جميع تكوينات Camera Link.

sections.heading: كيف أختار BNC أو DIN أو HD-BNC لوصلة CoaXPress؟
paragraphs: اقرأ اسم الموصل الدقيق في منفذي الجهازين. تحقق من القفل والوصول ومعدل الوصلة والطول وPoCXP وفق الدليلين. اطلب مراجعة التجميعة؛ لا تعتمد هذه القائمة طراز Qicable لكاميرا أو معدل CXP محدد.

cover.alt: GigE Vision: Paketverlust am Kabel oder im Netzwerk?

articles.description: GigE-Vision-Paketverluste durch getrennte Prüfung von Kabelverbindung, Netzwerklast und Aufnahmeeinstellungen eingrenzen. Kontrollierte Vergleiche helfen vor einem Kabeltausch.
articles.excerpt: GigE-Vision-Paketverluste durch getrennte Prüfung von Kabelverbindung, Netzwerklast und Aufnahmeeinstellungen eingrenzen. Kontrollierte Vergleiche helfen vor einem Kabeltausch.

sections.heading: Sind Paketverluste immer ein Kabelfehler?
paragraphs: Nein. Dokumentieren Sie unvollständige Bilder, Wiederholungszähler und Betriebsbedingungen. Vergleichen Sie dieselbe Kamera mit unveränderten Einstellungen an einer bekannten funktionierenden Verbindung. Ändern Sie jeweils nur ein Element, um Kabel-, Host-, Switch- und Konfigurationsprobleme unterscheiden zu können.

sections.heading: Zuerst die physische Verbindung prüfen
paragraphs: Kontrollieren Sie Steckersitz, Verriegelung, Beschädigungen und Belastung am Kabelabgang. Bei M12 auf RJ45 sind Codierung und freigegebene Pinbelegung zu prüfen. Vergleichen Sie den Kabelweg mit einer bekannten funktionierenden Leitung, ohne Kamera, Host und Einstellungen zu ändern. Beachten Sie die Gerätehinweise zu Anschluss und Versorgung.

sections.heading: Paketgröße, Paketabstand und gemeinsame Last prüfen
paragraphs: Prüfen Sie die unterstützte Paketgröße in Kamera, Netzwerkkarte und Switch. Folgen Sie der Kameraanleitung, statt eine Jumbo-Frame-Einstellung überall zu übernehmen. Ein größerer Inter-Packet Delay kann die Paketlast reduzieren, beeinflusst aber den Durchsatz. Betrachten Sie Kamerazahl, Bandbreite und benötigte Bildrate gemeinsam.

sections.heading: Welche Unterlagen braucht der Support?
paragraphs: Senden Sie Netzwerkskizze, Geräte- und Treiberversionen, Aufnahmeeinstellungen, Zähler und Vergleichsprotokoll. Treten Fehler nur bei mehreren Kameras oder einem bestimmten Switch auf, prüfen Sie diesen gemeinsamen Pfad. Bei unklarer Versorgung, Erdung oder Gerätefunktion keine spekulativen Änderungen vornehmen; Gerätehersteller einbeziehen.

bullets: Kabel, Treiber und Paketparameter gleichzeitig ändern und nur eine Ursache behaupten.
Schirmung oder Jumbo Frames als Lösung für jeden Bildverlust versprechen.

sections.heading: Especificar la terminación del blindaje

sections.heading: Verificar la instalación completa

cover.alt: Longueur USB3 Vision : câble passif, actif ou optique ?

articles.description: Choisissez la longueur USB3 Vision selon caméra, hôte, alimentation et cheminement. Comparez passif, actif et optique avant de convenir d’un essai d’acceptation.
articles.excerpt: Choisissez la longueur USB3 Vision selon caméra, hôte, alimentation et cheminement. Comparez passif, actif et optique avant de convenir d’un essai d’acceptation.

sections.heading: Existe-t-il une longueur USB3 Vision maximale universelle ?
paragraphs: Une longueur ne valide pas toutes les associations caméra-hôte. Relevez débit, puissance caméra, contrôleur et longueur installée. Sélectionnez la configuration selon les documents des équipements, puis vérifiez-la dans le montage prévu.

sections.heading: Cuivre passif, cuivre actif ou optique ?
paragraphs: Le passif ne comporte pas d’électronique de conditionnement ; le cuivre actif en ajoute et les solutions optiques convertissent le chemin de données. Vérifiez alimentation de l’électronique et de la caméra, sens des extrémités et limites de pose ou de mouvement. Un lien plus long n’est pas automatiquement interchangeable.

sections.heading: Que vérifier sur un câble caméra à verrouillage par vis ?
paragraphs: Contrôlez accouplement, accès aux vis, sortie et reprise d’effort. Notez résolution, format de pixel, cadence, hôte, alimentation et durée. Reproduisez mouvement et conditions prévus. Conservez erreurs et révision du plan ; un essai bref au repos ne remplace pas l’acceptation sur installation.

sections.heading: Quand revoir la conception du lien ?

articles.description: SPE vs 4-pair Ethernet at the sensor level: cable OD, bend radius, PoDL power budget, IP67 sealing and field assembly — plus what to verify before you release the BOM.
articles.excerpt: SPE vs 4-pair Ethernet at the sensor level: cable OD, bend radius, PoDL power budget, IP67 sealing and field assembly — plus what to verify before you release the BOM.
articles.primaryKeyword: single pair ethernet vs 4-pair ethernet sensor cabling

content.text: Pick Single Pair Ethernet when the field device is bandwidth-light (10BASE-T1L class), power-limited, and routed through tight or moving geometry where a smaller OD changes the build. Keep M12 X-coded 4-pair when the device needs higher throughput, familiar PoE practice, or a mature multi-vendor connector ecosystem. Two of those three answers come from datasheets, not marketing pages.

That is the whole decision in one paragraph. The rest of this article is about the work between reading it and releasing a BOM — because the SPE-versus-4-pair question rarely stalls on data rate. It stalls on a power budget measured at maximum ambient, and on whether the connectors at both ends of the link will actually mate.

sections.heading: Short answer: when SPE wins at the sensor, and when 4-pair still does

content.text: Most comparison content stops at "SPE is smaller." Size is real, but it is not the row that kills a project. The table below is organised by where each choice commits you during validation — and by who carries the risk if the answer turns out wrong.
Criterion

Numeric cells are deliberately left to the datasheet of the part you are specifying. Any article that hands you a generic outside diameter or bend radius for "SPE cable" is describing one supplier's construction, not the category.

sections.heading: Decision table: the criteria that actually change the BOM

content.text: Cable size becomes a design constraint in four situations: dense sensor clusters inside small enclosures, moving gantries, drag-chain fill weight, and robot wrist service loops. In each of them, a smaller OD does more than save space — it can change the minimum bend radius you must respect, the strain-relief hardware you need, and how much of the chain's fill weight is consumed by copper.
The size and weight benefit is real but is often repeated without attribution. The igus explainer on Single Pair Ethernet (published 12 February 2024,
toolbox.igus.com

) states that SPE cables can reduce installation size by 25% and weight by 35% over standard Ethernet cabling, and frames that benefit around automotive and railway applications where weight savings are critical. Two limits belong with that figure: the page reports no test method or measurement conditions in the passage, and the claim describes cable-level comparison in those industries — not a guarantee for your assembly, your jacket material, or your connector. Treat 25/35 as a directional planning input from a single publisher, then get the actual OD and weight per metre from the datasheet of the part you intend to buy.
Where the smaller cable does
not

pay for itself: high-flex duty cycles combined with heavy connectors, or short runs inside a cabinet where routing space was never the constraint. In those cases the geometry saving is invisible and you are taking on a new PHY, new connectors and new test equipment for no build-level return.
The concrete check: take the tightest real bend in the assembly drawing — including the service loop and the point where the cable exits the gland — and compare it against the
flexing
radius on the datasheet, not the fixed-installation radius. Static radii are frequently quoted because they are friendlier numbers. A drag-chain application lives in the flexing column.

sections.heading: Geometry: where the smaller cable pays for itself — and where it does not

content.text: SPE can carry power over the data line: Power over Data Line is specified in IEEE 802.3bu. What that standard does
not

do is tell you whether your specific sensor will receive enough volts at the end of your specific run at your specific cabinet temperature. This article cannot publish PoDL power classes or per-port budgets as conclusions for your build, because they are properties of the switch/PHY and the device, not of the cable category.
Instead, run the budget as a worksheet and put the numbers in the project file:

items.text: Device current draw
— from the device datasheet, at the operating point you actually run (worst case, not typical).
Loop resistance
— conductor resistance per metre × run length × 2, from the cable datasheet at the relevant temperature.
Voltage drop
— current × loop resistance. This is the line the cable supplier can genuinely help you calculate.
Ambient at the enclosure
— copper resistance rises with temperature, so a budget calculated at 20 °C and deployed at 60 °C is a different budget.
Resulting voltage at the device input
— compare against the device's minimum input voltage, including any brown-out margin the controls engineer wants.
Port budget
— confirm the switch's per-port power class and total budget in writing with the switch vendor.

content.text: Two things follow from that list. First, the cable supplier can confirm conductor gauge and resistance and nothing more; the power class is a switch-vendor and device-vendor statement. Second, a "powered over one pair" architecture can remove a separate 24 V field cable from some designs — which changes spare-parts strategy and how maintenance troubleshoots a dead sensor. That is a maintenance-acceptance decision, not an electrical one, and it should be signed off before it is designed in.

sections.heading: Power at the device: a PoDL budget worksheet

content.text: The 4-pair side of this decision is comfortable: M12 X-coded is a mature interface with broad multi-vendor availability, and most machine builders already have the crimp tooling, test adapters and spares on the shelf. The SPE side is newer, and the mating faces sit within the IEC 63171 series, with M8 and M12 quick-connect variants appearing at field level.

The procurement risk is this: two connectors can both be legitimately described as SPE and still not be interchangeable across vendors. Whether a given plug, socket and panel feed-through combination actually mates and holds its IP rating is an interoperability statement that must be confirmed in writing, vendor by vendor across the whole link — switch side, device side and any bulkhead in between. Make that confirmation an RFQ line item rather than an assumption at commissioning.

The IP67 path deserves the same treatment. Ingress protection on a terminated assembly is a property of the mated connector pair, the sealing at the panel feed-through and the torque applied at installation — not of the cable jacket. Whether you buy overmoulded cordsets or field-assembly connectors, name the connector part number in the IP67 claim and state who is accountable for the seal. Note also that a smaller cable changes gland and strain-relief selection: hardware sized for a 4-pair jacket may not clamp a single-pair cable correctly, and an over-clamped or under-clamped gland is a leak path.

Finally, quick-connect cordsets eliminate cable glands, housing disassembly and screw terminals. That is a labour and rework argument as much as an electrical one, and it often matters more to the build schedule than the per-metre cable price.

sections.heading: Connectors and IP67 sealing: the compatibility trap

items.text: IEEE 802.3cg
— the amendment covering 10BASE-T1L, the long-reach single-pair PHY most relevant to industrial field devices.
IEEE 802.3bu
— Power over Data Line.
IEC 63171 series
— the mating-face standards for single-pair connectors.
— the installation standard for industrial automation cabling, which has been amended to address 1-pair cabling.

content.text: None of these is a product certificate. Compliance with a PHY standard does not certify a complete channel end to end; a connector standard does not certify an assembly's IP rating; and an installation standard describes how cabling should be deployed, not how your specific cordset was built. Ask each supplier for the declaration of conformity and the exact standard revision they are working to, rather than accepting a logo on a datasheet.

sections.heading: Standards to name in the RFQ — and what they do not cover

content.text: A single-pair link has no spare conductors. Damage the pair and the link is dead — there is no degraded-but-working fallback. That raises the stakes on termination quality and test discipline compared with 4-pair, where a marginal pair sometimes limps along.

Decide termination ownership explicitly: factory-overmoulded assemblies put the sealing and the channel result on the assembly supplier, while field-assembly connectors put it on your technician and your tooling. Both are legitimate; a mix of the two without a named owner is where IP67 claims and test failures end up in dispute.
A bench and commissioning sequence a machine builder can actually run:

items.text: Continuity and pinout check on every cordset before installation.
Channel/performance test with a tester and adapter set matched to the interface being terminated.
PoDL voltage measurement at the device input, under load, at the ambient the enclosure will see.
Bend-cycle trial on the service loop for any moving axis, before the cable is dressed into the chain.
A documented pass/fail record per run, filed against the assembly part number.

content.text: Flag one schedule risk early: test adapters for SPE interfaces are not yet standard kit in every technician's case. Confirm adapter availability — and who buys them — before the commissioning window, not during it.

sections.heading: Field assembly, commissioning and test method

content.text: Comparing per-metre cable prices answers the wrong question. The cost of the channel includes the number of home-run cables per device, switch port density and single-pair switch availability, any media converters or gateways needed to reach existing infrastructure, spare-part strategy, and technician training on a new interface.

Halving the cable count per device changes panel space and cabinet wiring time — a labour line item that procurement often misses when comparing metres. And the honest framing runs both ways: the cheaper cable is not always the cheaper channel once converters and new test gear are counted, just as the familiar 4-pair option is not automatically the lower-risk one where geometry is the binding constraint.

sections.heading: Cost and lifecycle levers beyond cable price

content.text: Hand this to suppliers before you release the BOM, with a named sign-off for each line.
Item to confirm in writing
Sign-off

Controls engineering
PoDL power class and per-port budget confirmed by the switch/PHY vendor; device minimum input voltage confirmed by the device vendor
Controls engineering
Voltage-drop calculation completed at maximum ambient at the enclosure, with conductor resistance from the cable datasheet
Controls engineering
Mating-face interoperability documented across every vendor in the link, including bulkheads and panel feed-throughs
Procurement
Published
flexing
bend radius compared against the tightest real bend on the assembly drawing
Controls engineering
IP67 claim tied to a named connector part number and stated installation torque
Procurement
Termination ownership agreed: factory overmoulded versus field assembly, with accountability for sealing and channel result
Procurement / maintenance
Standard revision and declaration of conformity received from each supplier
Procurement
Test method, tester and adapter availability confirmed, including who purchases adapters
Maintenance
Maintenance acceptance of any loss of a separate 24 V field cable, and revised spare-parts strategy
Maintenance

sections.heading: Pre-BOM validation checklist

content.text: If the checklist above points to SPE, the fastest way to de-risk it is to test a physical sample against your real routing and your real device load. If it points to M12 X-coded 4-pair, you still need a datasheet that states bend radius in the flexing column for your specific part number.
Request a quote or sample for SPE / M12 X-coded sensor cable assemblies.

For a build-to-print quote on custom sensor and industrial Ethernet cable assemblies — connectors, overmoulding, IP67 sealing and per-part datasheets — send the following and you will get a specification back rather than a price list: the device list and required data rate, run lengths and the number of home runs, connector types at both ends, flex duty (static or drag chain, with cycle expectations), ambient temperature at the enclosure, required IP rating, and the tightest bend in the assembly drawing.

If your problem turns out to be link integrity rather than media choice — intermittent drops on an existing GigE Vision link, for example — the cabling question is secondary and the diagnosis should start elsewhere. Say so in your enquiry and we will point you at the right starting point.

sections.heading: Next step: samples and a build-to-print quote
Frequently asked questions

Devices needing higher throughput, familiar PoE practice, or connectors from a broad multi-vendor ecosystem usually stay on 4-pair M12 X-coded. Mixed architectures are common and normally the pragmatic answer.

sections.heading: Can Single Pair Ethernet replace 4-pair Ethernet for all sensors on a machine?

content.text: The power class and per-port budget are statements from the switch/PHY vendor and the device vendor — this article does not publish them as fixed values, because they depend on the specific hardware and on ambient temperature. Confirm both in writing, then calculate voltage drop from the device's worst-case current and the cable's conductor resistance over your actual run length.

sections.heading: How much power can PoDL deliver to a field sensor, and how do I confirm it for my device?

content.text: Not automatically. Mating faces are addressed within the IEC 63171 series, but whether a specific plug, socket and feed-through combination from different vendors mates and holds its IP rating must be confirmed in writing for every component in the link.

sections.heading: Are SPE M12 connectors from different vendors interoperable?

content.text: Specify against the published
flexing

radius for the exact part number, and compare it with the tightest real bend in the routing — including the service loop and the cable exit at the gland. Do not use the fixed-installation radius as a proxy; it is usually smaller and will not survive continuous movement.

sections.heading: Define the mounting interface
paragraphs: Specify front or rear installation, panel thickness and cutout geometry. Include hole spacing, fastener size and any anti-rotation feature. Identify the drawing revision and the face from which dimensions are measured.

sections.heading: Reserve space behind the panel
paragraphs: Show the connector body, cable exit and space needed to connect or remove the mating plug. Include nearby boards and enclosure walls. Check the available cable bend path after the panel is installed.

sections.heading: Review sealing and service access
paragraphs: Identify the gasket location, mating connector and installation instructions. Mechanical fit alone does not verify ingress protection. Agree the required assembled condition and inspection method, then approve a sample in the intended panel.

sections.heading: Which USB C panel mount cutout dimensions should I use?
paragraphs: Use the dimensioned drawing and revision for the exact model; there is no universal enclosure cutout for every USB-C panel-mount assembly. Check opening, hole centers, flange, fasteners and mating access. Confirm data, power and video functions separately from the connector's external shape.

sections.heading: How much panel thickness and rear clearance are needed?
paragraphs: Confirm the permitted panel stack, fastening method and connector body dimensions with the assembly drawing. Reserve room behind the panel for the cable exit, strain relief and bend, plus access for installation and replacement. Submit your enclosure drawing rather than copying a competitor's dimensions.

sections.heading: ¿Qué hace falta para cotizar?
paragraphs: Identifique dispositivos o referencias de conectores, género, codificación, bloqueo y salida. Defina referencias de longitud, tolerancia y ramificaciones. Añada cantidades de muestra y producción, destino y fecha requerida. Pida que oferta, supuestos y exclusiones queden por escrito.

sections.heading: ¿Cómo definir plano y pinout?
paragraphs: Distinga vista de acoplamiento y lado de cableado; asigne señales, pantalla y contactos sin uso. Numere la revisión y marque puntos pendientes. Sin plano, aporte fotos de puertos y manuales. Una ilustración genérica no es un plano de fabricación aprobado.

sections.heading: ¿Cómo acordar la aceptación de muestras?
paragraphs: Separe ajuste mecánico, comprobaciones eléctricas y funcionamiento. Acuerde método, límites, cantidad y criterios antes de aprobar. Documente condiciones de movimiento y ambiente cuando importen. La continuidad no demuestra velocidad, estanqueidad ni vida en ciclos.

sections.heading: ¿Qué confirmar para repetir un pedido?
paragraphs: Vincule muestra aprobada y revisión al pedido. Acuerde etiquetas, embalaje, registros y revisión de sustituciones o cambios. Consulte MOQ, validez de precio, herramientas y plazo para esa configuración; esta lista no promete mínimos ni plazos universales.

sections.heading: Gibt es eine allgemeine maximale USB3-Vision-Kabellänge?
paragraphs: Eine Länge bestätigt nicht jede Kombination aus Kamera und Host. Erfassen Sie Datenrate, Leistungsbedarf, Hostcontroller und installierte Länge. Wählen Sie anhand der konkreten Kabelausführung und Geräteunterlagen einen Kandidaten und prüfen Sie ihn im vorgesehenen Aufbau.

sections.heading: Passives Kupfer, aktives Kupfer oder optisch?
paragraphs: Passive Kabel enthalten keine Elektronik zur Signalaufbereitung; aktive Kupferkabel enthalten Elektronik, optische Varianten wandeln den Datenpfad um. Klären Sie Versorgung von Elektronik und Kamera, mögliche Richtungsbindung sowie Verlege- und Bewegungsgrenzen für jede Ausführung. Eine längere Verbindung ist nicht automatisch austauschbar.

sections.heading: Was umfasst die Prüfung eines Kamerakabels mit Schraubverriegelung?
paragraphs: Prüfen Sie Gegenstecker, Schraubzugang, Abgang und Zugentlastung. Protokollieren Sie Auflösung, Pixelformat, Bildrate, Host, Versorgung und Prüfdauer. Wiederholen Sie die Prüfung bei vorgesehener Bewegung und Betriebsumgebung. Fehlerprotokolle gehören zur Zeichnungsversion; ein kurzer Leerlauftest ersetzt keine Anlagenabnahme.

sections.heading: Wann sollte die Verbindung neu ausgelegt werden?
paragraphs: Ändern Sie bei Fehlern jeweils nur einen Faktor: bekannte kurze Verbindung vergleichen, Versorgung und Host prüfen, dann andere Übertragungstechnik mit dem Gerätehersteller abstimmen. Qicable kann die Konfiguration prüfen; diese Anleitung belegt keine getestete Maximallänge eines Qicable-Modells.

sections.heading: How do I check RS485 A/B polarity?
paragraphs: Do not assign wires from color or A/B letters alone. Compare the converter and device manuals, including their signal definitions and pin views, then document the intended pair. Follow the equipment supplier's procedure for correcting polarity; do not experiment on energized unknown terminals. Keep power, signal reference and protective earth distinct.

sections.heading: Where should RS485 termination be checked?
paragraphs: Review the actual bus topology and existing termination with the device documentation. Termination is a network-design decision, not a resistor to add at every device. Identify built-in termination and biasing before adding components. Record branches and cable lengths so the supplier can review the complete link.

sections.heading: Why does a Modbus connection time out?
paragraphs: Check that the correct serial port and supported driver are selected, then compare baud rate, parity, stop bits, device address and the requested protocol. RS485 specifies an electrical interface, not a guarantee of Modbus compatibility. Isolate a permitted single-device link before adding the rest of the network.

sections.heading: What must be confirmed for the exact converter cable?
paragraphs: Ask for the model's wiring diagram, supported operating systems, driver source, electrical interface and any isolation or power requirements. Do not infer a chipset, isolation rating or terminal arrangement from USB or RS485 labels. Send the comparison log and manuals when the failure remains unresolved.

paragraphs: Provide the available bend radius, travel, speed, acceleration and cycle schedule. Add carrier layout, clamping points and exposure to oil or heat. Identify where movement starts relative to the connector and strain relief.

sections.heading: Agree a relevant validation
paragraphs: Ask for a cable construction and test proposal that matches this installation. Define the signal checks and inspection intervals for the sample. Compare any cycle-life statement with its stated test conditions before using it in a purchasing specification.

sections.heading: Continuous flex vs torsion: can one rating cover both?
paragraphs: Continuous bending in a cable carrier and twisting around an axis are different loads. A continuous-flex statement alone is not evidence of torsion suitability. Describe where each movement occurs and request validation for the actual combination instead of assuming that a flexible cable suits a robot joint.

sections.heading: How should minimum bend radius and cycle-life claims be compared?
paragraphs: Keep the exact construction, installed radius, travel, speed, acceleration, temperature, torsion angle and failure criterion with the result. A cycle count without these conditions is not directly comparable. Request the relevant record or agree a sample test; this guide supplies no Qicable cycle-life rating.

sections.heading: What information is needed to quote a custom cable?
paragraphs: Identify both mating devices or connector part numbers, contact gender, coding, locking and exit direction. Define the length measurement points, tolerance and branch positions. Include sample and production quantities, delivery destination and the required date. Ask for assumptions and exclusions to be written in the quotation.

sections.heading: How should the drawing and pinout be defined?
paragraphs: Label mating-face or wiring-side views and map every signal, shield and unused contact. Give the drawing a revision and record unresolved fields explicitly. If you do not have a drawing, send port photos and equipment documents for review. A generic connector illustration is not an approved production drawing.

sections.heading: How do you agree sample acceptance?
paragraphs: Separate mechanical fit, electrical checks and equipment operation. Agree the test method, limits, sample quantity and pass/fail criteria before approval. Where motion or environmental performance matters, record the conditions to be checked. Do not treat a continuity check as proof of high-speed, sealing or cycle-life performance.

sections.heading: What should be confirmed before repeat production?
paragraphs: Keep the approved sample identification and drawing revision with the order. Confirm labeling, packaging, test records and how substitutions or design changes are reviewed. Ask for MOQ, price validity, tooling and delivery timing for this configuration; no universal minimum quantity or lead time is promised by this checklist.

sections.heading: Como confirmar a polaridade A/B?

sections.heading: Onde verificar a terminação RS485?
paragraphs: Reveja topologia e terminações existentes segundo a documentação. A terminação é uma decisão de rede, não uma resistência em cada dispositivo. Identifique terminação e polarização internas antes de acrescentar componentes. Registe ramais e comprimentos.

sections.heading: Porque termina o tempo de espera Modbus?
paragraphs: Verifique porta e controlador suportado; depois velocidade, paridade, bits de paragem, endereço e protocolo. RS485 define uma interface elétrica, não garante Modbus. Isole uma ligação permitida com um dispositivo antes de ampliar a rede.

sections.heading: O que confirmar no conversor concreto?
paragraphs: Peça esquema, sistemas suportados, fonte do controlador e requisitos elétricos, de isolamento ou alimentação. As designações USB e RS485 não provam chipset ou isolamento. Envie manuais e comparação se a falha continuar.

articles.description: Drag chain cable selection starts with four RFQ specs. See how to write bend radius, cycles, jacket and lengths so quotes are comparable and failures drop.
articles.excerpt: Drag chain cable selection starts with four RFQ specs. See how to write bend radius, cycles, jacket and lengths so quotes are comparable and failures drop.
articles.primaryKeyword: drag chain cable selection

content.text: A drag chain cable RFQ is only comparable when four fields are written into the drawing:

minimum bend radius under continuous flex (as a multiple of cable OD), life cycles with the test conditions that produced them, jacket compound with its test data, and the fixed-end / moving-end clamp positions and lengths
. Leave any one out and each supplier prices to its own assumption — in practice, a static-flex cable at a static-flex price.

That is the whole decision. There is no universal bend radius and no universal cycle life for drag chain cable; both are properties of a specific construction tested under specific motion conditions. So the purpose of the RFQ is not to name a number you found online — it is to force every bidder to publish the basis of its number, so the quotes sit on the same page and the acceptance test is agreed before the purchase order.
If the drawing does not oblige the supplier to confirm all four items in writing, the RFQ is not ready to send. Everything below is about getting that confirmation onto paper.

sections.heading: Drag chain cable selection: what the quote must prove

content.text: "Flexible cable" describes a stranding and compound choice that tolerates bending during installation and occasional repositioning. Drag chain cable — also sold as continuous flex, tow chain or cable carrier cable — is built to bend in one plane, millions of times, around a fixed radius, inside a moving carrier. The two are different products with different bill of materials and different prices.

When the drawing says only "flexible cable", a supplier that quotes a static-flex product is not cheating; it is answering the question you asked. The mismatch only becomes visible weeks after installation, when the conductor or jacket at the chain entry point gives up — and at that stage the re-purchase, downtime and rework cost far exceeds the unit-price gap that made the cheap quote look attractive.
An illustrative redline, not a real customer case, shows what happens:
What the drawing says
What a supplier can reasonably read
What the application actually needs
"Flexible cable, 4×1.5 mm², 5 m"
Static-flex hook-up cable, cut to 5 m
Continuous-flex construction rated for the chain radius
No bend radius stated
Installation bend radius from a generic catalogue page
Continuous-flex minimum bend radius, as × OD, ≤ chain radius
No life cycle stated
No cycle claim made at all
Cycle figure with travel, speed, acceleration, radius, duty cycle
"PUR jacket"
Any compound the supplier calls PUR
Named compound and hardness, with oil / abrasion / temperature data

sections.heading: Why "flexible cable" produces non-comparable quotes

content.text: For machines built to EU or North American requirements, the cable quote also has to carry paper. Two distinctions matter and are routinely blurred in quotations:

items.text: Component rule vs machine rule.

CE marking applies to the machinery as a whole; a cable is a component supplied under material restrictions such as RoHS and, where relevant, REACH declarations. Ask the supplier which regime the cable itself is declared against, and do not accept "CE" printed on a cable datasheet as evidence of a machine-level conformity assessment.
Factory certification vs model-level listing.

A plant holding a quality-system certificate does not mean the specific part number you are buying is recognised by UL, CSA or another listing body. Require the file/style reference for the exact construction, and confirm it applies to the flexing version, not just the static version of the same family.

content.text: Any specific standard number, temperature class or approval that is not printed on the supplier's datasheet for that part number should be treated as unverified until it is. That is a documentation request, not a technical argument.

sections.heading: Compliance: ask for the declaration level, not a logo

content.text: Bend radius must be specified three ways, because they are three different limits: the fixed-installation radius, the occasional-moving radius, and the continuous-flex radius. A cable rated for the first two can still fail in the third. Only the continuous-flex figure belongs in a drag chain RFQ.
Write it as a multiple of cable OD, and pair it with the chain's actual radius. The requirement is that the cable's continuous-flex minimum bend radius is
less than or equal to
the radius the chain will impose — and the supplier should show that comparison arithmetically, because it is the one calculation that catches a wrong cable before it is cut.
For scale only: LIONSHELL's published drag chain guide,
The Complete Guide to Cable Drag Chains

, states that typical bend radii range from 28 mm to 150 mm and advises using cable with a known minimum bend radius and selecting a chain that accommodates or exceeds it. That is a chain supplier's reference range for chain geometry — it is not a cable specification and not an industry threshold. The cable datasheet for your part number is the only acceptable source for the cable value.
Copy-ready drawing note:
"Cable minimum bend radius: __ × OD, continuous flex, to be installed in chain radius __ mm. Supplier to confirm in writing that cable minimum bend radius ≤ chain radius, showing the calculation."

sections.heading: 1. Minimum bend radius: write the cable OD multiple and the chain radius

content.text: A cycle count with no conditions attached is marketing, not a specification. Cycle life moves with travel length, speed, acceleration, bend radius, duty cycle, cable fill in the carrier and the environment. A headline figure from a catalogue page cannot be transferred to your machine without those parameters.
Require the supplier to state, for the quoted part number,
whether the number is a design target, a laboratory test result or a field estimate
, and under what conditions. Vendors do publish cycle bands: NPC Electric's comparison guide,
Drag Chain Cable vs Flexible Cable vs High-Flex Cable vs Robot Cable

, positions drag chain cable at roughly 5–20+ million bend cycles in linear motion systems. Use that only as an illustration of how a vendor frames its own range — it is not a threshold your application has to meet, and it is not a guarantee for a different construction or a different motion profile.
Copy-ready drawing note:

"Continuous flex life: __ cycles at travel __ mm, speed __ m/s, acceleration __ m/s², bend radius __ mm, duty cycle __%. Supplier to state test basis (lab / field / target) and test standard or method."
Leave the numeric blanks for your own motion profile, then verify the claim with a sample on your machine. A datasheet sets the expectation; the sample test is what accepts or rejects the part.

sections.heading: 2. Life cycles: force the test conditions into the RFQ

content.text: Neither TPE nor PUR is "better". They are families, and within each family the compound, hardness and filler package change abrasion resistance, oil resistance, low-temperature flexibility, hydrolysis behaviour and flex fatigue. That is why a quotation that says only "PUR" tells you almost nothing you can compare.
Frame the choice against the actual risk in the cell:

items.text: Abrasion and hot chips
— metalworking, grinding, woodworking dust. Ask for abrasion test data and, where relevant, chip resistance evidence; a closed or tubular carrier may be part of the answer.
Oil and coolant
— machine tool sumps, hydraulic areas. Ask for oil-resistance data at the relevant temperature and duration, not just an "oil resistant" adjective.
Low temperature
— cold stores, outdoor gantries, unheated halls. Flexibility at low temperature is a separate property from room-temperature flex life.
Welding spatter
— a standard oil-resistant jacket is usually not sufficient on its own; this needs a specific verification step with the supplier, often a different jacket or an additional mechanical protection.

content.text: Ask for the compound designation and hardness, plus oil, abrasion and temperature data. If the data does not exist for the compound offered, that is a finding worth recording in the quote comparison rather than a detail to skip.
Copy-ready drawing note:
"Jacket: TPE / PUR (select), supplier to state compound designation, hardness and oil / abrasion / temperature test data. Generic flexible PVC is not acceptable."

sections.heading: 3. Jacket material: TPE vs PUR is a risk trade, not a default

content.text: Length is not "travel distance plus a bit". It has to account for the travel, the chain bend arc, the position of the fixed-end clamp and the moving-end clamp, the strain relief method, and the free cable beyond each clamp. Underspecified clamp positions are a common reason a technically correct cable is installed at the wrong length and then fails at the entry point rather than in the middle of the run.
Cable-sizing practice also varies on how much clearance to leave in the carrier. Hebei Huatong's sizing guide,
Drag Chain Cable Sizes Guide

, advises adding 10% to the maximum OD for electrical cables. Treat that as one supplier's published practice and confirm the clearance rule with your chain supplier and cable supplier together — inner height and inner width rules differ by carrier design, and fill weight matters as much as diameter.
Copy-ready drawing note:
"Fixed end at __, moving end at __, clamp type __, free cable length beyond clamp __ mm. Supplier to confirm chain clearance and strain relief arrangement."

sections.heading: 4. Fixed and moving lengths: define the chain entry points

content.text: Paste these into the drawing notes block, or attach them as a specification sheet referenced by the drawing. Every blank is either your application value or a value the supplier must return.
RFQ field
Drawing annotation
Evidence the supplier must return
Bend radius
Minimum bend radius __ × OD, continuous flex; chain radius __ mm
Datasheet value plus the radius comparison calculation
Life cycles
__ cycles at travel __ mm, speed __ m/s, accel. __ m/s², radius __ mm, duty __%
Test basis, method and conditions for the quoted figure
Jacket
TPE / PUR, compound and hardness to be stated
Compound designation, oil / abrasion / temperature data
Lengths and clamping
Fixed end __, moving end __, clamp type __, free length __ mm
Clearance and strain-relief confirmation
Construction
Continuous-flex conductor stranding and lay, shield type, fillers
Construction data for the exact part number
Compliance
Declared material and listing regime for this part number
Declaration references and file/style numbers where claimed
Acceptance line to close the notes:

"Supplier to confirm all four fields in writing. Quote must state cable construction, bend radius basis, cycle test conditions and jacket compound. Sample required for test on buyer's motion profile before series release."

sections.heading: Copy-ready RFQ notes for your drawing

items.text: What conductor stranding and lay length is used, and is that construction designed for continuous flexing rather than static flex? (Fine stranding alone is not proof; the lay and the fillers matter.)
What is the stated minimum bend radius under continuous flex, and what test method or datasheet basis supports it?
What cycle life is claimed — at what travel, speed, acceleration, bend radius and duty cycle — and is it a lab result, a field estimate or a design target?
What jacket compound and hardness are supplied, and what oil, abrasion and temperature data is available for that compound?
What sample length and lead time can be provided so we can run a like-for-like test on our own motion profile?

sections.heading: Five questions to ask before accepting a drag chain cable quote

content.text: The single most common mismatch is a continuous-flex requirement answered with a static-flex price. The failure modes below are verification points to check in the construction data, not predictions of a failure rate:

items.text: Conductor break
— coarse stranding or a lay optimised for static bending. Check stranding class and lay direction, not just copper cross-section.
Jacket cracking
— wrong compound for the oil, temperature or abrasion load, or insufficient wall thickness at the flex point. Check compound data against the environment.
Shield fatigue
— drain-wire or braid construction that work-hardens in continuous bending. Check shield type and how it terminates at the clamp.
Core migration and length change
— poor fillers or lay allowing cores to shift under repeated bending. Check filler and cabling construction.

content.text: None of these can be settled from a catalogue headline. They are settled by the supplier returning construction data and by you testing a sample.

sections.heading: Common mismatches and the failure modes they hide

content.text: The decision rule is simple. If all four fields are in the drawing and the supplier has confirmed them in writing, you can compare quotes like-for-like and release a sample with a defined acceptance test. If any field is missing, you are not comparing quotes — you are comparing assumptions, and the cheapest one wins for the wrong reason.
Send your drag chain drawing or motion profile for a like-for-like quote and a cable sample.

Include the chain radius, travel, speed and acceleration, duty cycle, environment and clamp positions if you have them; if some values are still open, say so, and they can be fixed jointly before quoting rather than after delivery. Ask for the datasheet and a sample length with the quote, so the four fields can be verified on your machine rather than on a catalogue page.

sections.heading: When to stop specifying and send the motion profile
FAQ

content.text: Specify it as a multiple of cable OD under continuous-flex conditions, and require the resulting value to be less than or equal to the actual chain radius. No universal multiple exists — it depends on the construction. There is no substitute for the datasheet value for your part number and the supplier's written radius comparison.

sections.heading: What bend radius should I specify for drag chain cable?

content.text: Not universally. Both are families whose compounds differ in hardness, abrasion, oil and low-temperature behaviour. Choose against the dominant risk in the cell — abrasion and chips, oil and coolant, low temperature, or welding spatter — and require compound-specific test data rather than the family name.

sections.heading: Is PUR better than TPE for drag chain cable jackets?

content.text: The number has to come from your motion profile, not from a catalogue. State your cycles required at your travel, speed, acceleration, radius and duty cycle, and ask the supplier to confirm its figure on the same basis. Without those conditions, a cycle count cannot be compared between suppliers or accepted as an acceptance criterion.

sections.heading: How many cycles should a drag chain cable be rated for?

content.text: Flexible cable tolerates bending during installation and occasional movement. Continuous-flex drag chain cable is constructed to bend repeatedly in one plane around a fixed radius inside a carrier, and is specified by bend radius, cycle life under defined conditions, and jacket compound — the four RFQ fields this checklist covers.

sections.heading: What is the difference between flexible cable and continuous flex drag chain cable?

sections.heading: Comment vérifier la polarité A/B ?
paragraphs: Ne déduisez pas l’affectation des couleurs ou seules lettres A/B. Comparez définitions des signaux et vues dans les deux manuels. Suivez la procédure du fabricant pour corriger la polarité, sans expérimenter sur des bornes inconnues sous tension. Distinguez alimentation, référence de signal et terre de protection.

sections.heading: Où vérifier la terminaison RS485 ?
paragraphs: Examinez topologie et terminaisons selon les documents. La terminaison relève du réseau, pas d’une résistance ajoutée à chaque appareil. Identifiez résistances et polarisation intégrées avant tout ajout. Relevez dérivations et longueurs pour examiner la liaison complète.

sections.heading: Pourquoi une communication Modbus expire-t-elle ?
paragraphs: Vérifiez port et pilote pris en charge, puis débit, parité, bits d’arrêt, adresse et protocole. RS485 définit une interface électrique, sans garantir Modbus. Isolez une liaison autorisée avec un appareil avant de compléter le réseau.

sections.heading: Que confirmer pour le convertisseur exact ?
paragraphs: Demandez schéma, systèmes pris en charge, source du pilote et exigences d’interface, isolation ou alimentation. Les mentions USB et RS485 ne prouvent ni chipset ni isolation. Transmettez manuels et journal comparatif si le défaut persiste.

articles.description: Diferencie instalação fixa, flexão repetida e torção antes de escolher o cabo. Descrever o movimento real é mais útil do que pedir apenas um cabo flexível.
articles.excerpt: Diferencie instalação fixa, flexão repetida e torção antes de escolher o cabo. Descrever o movimento real é mais útil do que pedir apenas um cabo flexível.

sections.heading: Classificar o movimento
paragraphs: Marque onde o cabo fica fixo, dobra na esteira ou gira em torno do eixo. Flexão contínua e torção são cargas diferentes. Se ambas ocorrerem, indique os locais e se são simultâneas.

sections.heading: Registrar as condições de instalação
paragraphs: Informe raio disponível, curso, velocidade, aceleração e programação de ciclos. Acrescente esteira, fixações e exposição a óleo ou calor. Indique onde começa o movimento em relação ao conector e ao alívio de tração.

sections.heading: Combinar uma validação pertinente
paragraphs: Solicite construção e ensaio adequados à instalação. Defina verificações de sinal e intervalos de inspeção da amostra. Compare qualquer vida útil informada com suas condições de ensaio antes de incluí-la na especificação de compra.

sections.heading: Flexão contínua e torção: basta uma classificação?
paragraphs: Flexão numa esteira e rotação sobre um eixo são cargas diferentes. Continuous-flex não prova aptidão para torção. Descreva ambas e peça validação da combinação real, sem presumir aptidão para uma articulação robótica.

sections.heading: Como comparar raio mínimo e vida em ciclos?
paragraphs: Registe construção, raio, curso, velocidade, aceleração, temperatura, ângulo de torção e critério de falha. Ciclos sem essas condições não são comparáveis. Peça registos ou acorde um teste; este guia não declara vida em ciclos Qicable.

cover.alt: توصيل USB إلى RS485: القطبية والإنهاء ومهلة الاتصال

articles.description: تحقق من توصيل USB إلى RS485 وتعريفات A/B والإنهاء والإعدادات قبل استبدال المحول. استخدم دليلي الجهازين ووثّق اختبارات العزل.
articles.excerpt: تحقق من توصيل USB إلى RS485 وتعريفات A/B والإنهاء والإعدادات قبل استبدال المحول. استخدم دليلي الجهازين ووثّق اختبارات العزل.

relatedLinks.label: Texas Instruments · The RS-485 Design Guide

sections.heading: كيف أتحقق من قطبية A/B؟
paragraphs: لا تحدد الأسلاك باللون أو حروف A/B فقط. قارن تعريفات الإشارات ومناظر الأطراف في دليلي المحول والجهاز. اتبع إجراء المصنّع للتصحيح ولا تجرب على أطراف مجهولة تحت الجهد. ميّز التغذية ومرجع الإشارة والتأريض الوقائي.

sections.heading: أين يُفحص إنهاء RS485؟
paragraphs: راجع طوبولوجيا الناقل والإنهاء الموجود وفق الوثائق. الإنهاء قرار تصميم شبكة وليس مقاومة تُضاف لكل جهاز. حدّد الإنهاء والتحييز الداخليين قبل إضافة مكونات. سجّل التفرعات والأطوال لمراجعة الوصلة كاملة.

sections.heading: لماذا تنتهي مهلة اتصال Modbus؟
paragraphs: راجع المنفذ والتعريف المدعوم أولًا ثم سرعة الاتصال والتكافؤ وبتات التوقف والعنوان والبروتوكول. يعرّف RS485 واجهة كهربائية ولا يضمن توافق Modbus. اعزل وصلة مسموحة بجهاز واحد قبل توسيع الشبكة.

sections.heading: ما الذي يجب تأكيده للمحول المحدد؟
paragraphs: اطلب مخطط التوصيل والأنظمة المدعومة ومصدر التعريف ومتطلبات الواجهة والعزل والتغذية. لا تثبت تسميات USB وRS485 نوع الشريحة أو تصنيف العزل. أرسل الدليلين وسجل المقارنة إذا استمر العطل.

articles.description: Préparez votre demande de devis avec interfaces, vues du brochage, longueur et essais. Une révision claire du plan facilite la comparaison et l’acceptation des échantillons.
articles.excerpt: Préparez votre demande de devis avec interfaces, vues du brochage, longueur et essais. Une révision claire du plan facilite la comparaison et l’acceptation des échantillons.

sections.heading: Que faut-il pour établir un devis ?
paragraphs: Identifiez équipements ou références, genre des contacts, codage, verrouillage et sortie. Définissez points de mesure, tolérance et dérivations. Ajoutez quantités d’échantillons et de série, destination et date requise. Faites préciser hypothèses et exclusions dans l’offre.

sections.heading: Comment définir plan et brochage ?
paragraphs: Distinguez face d’accouplement et côté câblage ; affectez chaque signal, blindage et contact inutilisé. Indiquez révision et points ouverts. Sans plan, fournissez photos des ports et manuels. Une illustration générique n’est pas un plan de production approuvé.

sections.heading: Comment accepter un échantillon ?
paragraphs: Séparez ajustement mécanique, contrôles électriques et fonctionnement. Convenez méthode, limites, quantité et critères avant validation. Documentez mouvement et environnement pertinents. La continuité ne démontre ni haut débit, ni étanchéité, ni durée de vie en cycles.

sections.heading: Que confirmer pour une nouvelle série ?
paragraphs: Associez échantillon approuvé et révision au bon de commande. Convenez étiquetage, emballage, rapports et gestion des changements. Demandez MOQ, validité du prix, outillage et délai pour cette configuration ; aucune valeur universelle n’est promise.

articles.description: Un câble de panneau doit convenir au boîtier et aux connecteurs des deux côtés. Utilisez un plan d’installation coté avant d’approuver la découpe ou la commande.
articles.excerpt: Un câble de panneau doit convenir au boîtier et aux connecteurs des deux côtés. Utilisez un plan d’installation coté avant d’approuver la découpe ou la commande.

sections.heading: Définir l’interface de fixation
paragraphs: Précisez montage avant ou arrière, épaisseur et forme de découpe. Incluez entraxe, visserie et dispositif antirotation. Identifiez la révision du plan et la face de référence des cotes.

sections.heading: Réserver l’espace arrière
paragraphs: Montrez le corps du connecteur, la sortie du câble et l’espace pour brancher ou retirer la fiche. Ajoutez cartes et parois voisines. Vérifiez la courbure disponible une fois le panneau installé.

sections.heading: Contrôler étanchéité et maintenance
paragraphs: Identifiez joint, contrepartie et consignes de montage. L’ajustement mécanique seul ne valide pas l’indice de protection. Convenez de l’état assemblé et de son inspection, puis approuvez un échantillon sur le panneau prévu.

sections.heading: Quelles dimensions de découpe pour un USB-C de panneau ?
paragraphs: Utilisez le plan coté et la révision du modèle exact ; aucune découpe universelle ne couvre tous les assemblages USB-C. Vérifiez ouverture, entraxes, bride, fixations et accès. Confirmez données, puissance et vidéo indépendamment de la forme externe.

sections.heading: Quelle épaisseur et quel dégagement arrière prévoir ?
paragraphs: Confirmez empilage du panneau, fixation et corps avec le plan. Réservez sortie, reprise d’effort, courbure et accès pour montage ou remplacement. Envoyez votre plan de boîtier au lieu de copier des cotes d’une autre marque.

articles.description: Especifique un conjunto M12 por codificación, contactos y cableado, y después confirme su montaje. El nombre M12 no basta como especificación de compra.
articles.excerpt: Especifique un conjunto M12 por codificación, contactos y cableado, y después confirme su montaje. El nombre M12 no basta como especificación de compra.

relatedLinks.label: Molex · M12 coding and contact configurations

sections.heading: Leer la designación del puerto
paragraphs: Copie la designación completa del manual del equipo. Las codificaciones D y X aparecen en productos Ethernet M12. No elija un sustituto solo por la rosca: confirme la codificación de ambos extremos.

sections.heading: Definir un mapa de pines inequívoco
paragraphs: Indique número de contactos, macho o hembra y cada conexión entre pines. Señale si el dibujo muestra la cara de acoplamiento o de cableado. Documente el blindaje aparte y confirme los contactos sin uso.

sections.heading: Comprobar la conexión completa
paragraphs: Confirme cuerpo recto o acodado, acceso de apriete, salida y pieza de acoplamiento. Solicite requisitos eléctricos y ambientales para todo el conjunto. Una codificación compatible no demuestra por sí sola prestaciones ensayadas.

sections.heading: M12 D coded frente a X coded: ¿son intercambiables?
paragraphs: No. D suele usar cuatro contactos y X ocho, con distinta codificación. Elija según cada dispositivo. Número de contactos o rosca M12 no prueban las prestaciones Ethernet del conjunto.

sections.heading: ¿Cómo verificar el pinout M12 a RJ45?
paragraphs: Use el plano del modelo e identifique cara de acoplamiento o lado de cableado. Relacione contactos con posiciones RJ45 y confirme pantalla y contactos sin uso. No copie colores de otro modelo o fabricante.

sections.heading: ¿Qué definir en un cable de sensor M8/M12 abierto?
paragraphs: Indique puerto, codificación, género, número de contactos y asignación de cada hilo. Confirme longitud libre y terminación. Un extremo abierto no sustituye la definición de conexiones del dispositivo ni hace intercambiables sus interfaces.

bullets: Pedir solo por número de pines sin indicar codificación.
Invertir un mapa de pines por no identificar la vista del dibujo.

relatedLinks.label: Molex · M12 coding and contact configurations

sections.heading: Relever la désignation du port
paragraphs: Recopiez la désignation complète du manuel de l’appareil. Les codages D et X existent sur les produits Ethernet M12. Ne choisissez pas un remplacement uniquement par le filetage : confirmez le codage aux deux extrémités.

sections.heading: Rendre le brochage explicite
paragraphs: Indiquez le nombre de contacts, mâles ou femelles, et chaque liaison entre broches. Précisez la vue côté accouplement ou câblage. Documentez le blindage séparément des signaux et faites confirmer les contacts inutilisés.

sections.heading: Vérifier la liaison assemblée
paragraphs: Confirmez corps droit ou coudé, accès au serrage, sortie et contrepartie. Demandez les exigences électriques et environnementales pour l’ensemble. Un codage mécaniquement compatible ne constitue pas une preuve de performances testées.

sections.heading: M12 codé D ou X : interchangeables ?
paragraphs: Non. Le codage D utilise généralement quatre contacts et le X huit, avec un détrompage différent. Choisissez selon chaque appareil. Nombre de contacts et filetage M12 ne démontrent pas les performances Ethernet de l’ensemble.

sections.heading: Comment vérifier le brochage M12 vers RJ45 ?
paragraphs: Utilisez le plan exact et précisez face d’accouplement ou côté câblage. Associez contacts et positions RJ45, puis confirmez blindage et contacts inutilisés. Ne copiez pas les couleurs d’un autre modèle ou fabricant.

sections.heading: Que définir pour un câble capteur M8/M12 à fils libres ?
paragraphs: Précisez port, codage, genre, nombre de contacts et affectation des fils. Confirmez longueur dénudée et raccordement. Une extrémité libre ne définit pas la connexion à l’appareil et ne rend pas les interfaces interchangeables.
